name: Institution workflow demo
description: A deterministic text pipeline: prepare the input, count its words, and return a summary. No model or external tools are used.

nodes.label: Prepare text
nodes.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from the supplied text.

nodes.label: Count words
nodes.description: Count nonempty tokens separated by whitespace. Empty text has zero words.

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.description: Return a deterministic message using the text and word count from the previous step.
